hc.name: Jesse Minter
hc.bio: Jesse Minter is the head coach of the Baltimore Ravens in 2026, the fourth head coach in franchise history after the club hired him on January 22, 2026. He was defensive coordinator of the Los Angeles Chargers in 2024–25 and of Michigan in 2022–23, and he was a Ravens defensive assistant (2017–18), assistant defensive backs coach (2019), and defensive backs coach (2020). Wikipedia and the Ravens hire story say he played wide receiver at Mount St. Joseph University from 2002 to 2005.

oc.name: Declan Doyle
oc.bio: Declan Doyle is the offensive coordinator of the Baltimore Ravens in 2026. The Ravens 2026 staff announcement says this is his eighth NFL coaching season and second as an offensive coordinator after he was Chicago’s OC in 2025, when the Bears ranked sixth in total yards. He was Denver’s tight ends coach in 2023–24 and a New Orleans offensive assistant in 2019–22; Wikipedia says the Ravens hired him on February 2, 2026 after one season in Chicago.

dc.name: Anthony Weaver
dc.bio: Anthony Weaver is the defensive coordinator of the Baltimore Ravens in 2026, his third stint with the club after playing defensive end there from 2002–05 and coaching in Baltimore from 2021–23. The Ravens hire page says he was Miami’s defensive coordinator in 2024–25 and Houston’s defensive coordinator/defensive line coach in 2020 after defensive-line jobs with the Jets, Bills, Browns, and Texans. Baltimore drafted him in the second round in 2002; he also played at Notre Dame.

st.name: Anthony Levine Sr.
st.bio: Anthony Levine Sr. is the special teams coordinator of the Baltimore Ravens in 2026. The Ravens staff announcement says this is his third season as a Ravens special teams coach and first as coordinator after 10 seasons as a special teams standout in Baltimore (2012–21). After retiring he was a Ravens player personnel/coaching assistant in 2022, Titans assistant special teams coach in 2023–24, and Ravens assistant special teams coach in 2025.

hc.name: Joe Brady
hc.bio: Joe Brady is the head coach of the Buffalo Bills in 2026, the 21st in franchise history, after agreeing to a five-year deal on January 27, 2026. The Bills say he was offensive coordinator in 2024–25, interim OC for the final nine games of 2023, and quarterbacks coach in 2022–23. Before Buffalo he was Carolina’s offensive coordinator in 2020–21, an offensive assistant with New Orleans in 2017–18, and LSU passing-game coordinator/wide receivers coach in 2019; the team says he played wide receiver at William & Mary from 2009–12.

oc.name: Pete Carmichael Jr.
oc.bio: Pete Carmichael Jr. is the offensive coordinator of the Buffalo Bills in 2026 under head coach Joe Brady. Wikipedia says he was New Orleans’ offensive coordinator from 2009–23 (quarterbacks coach in 2006; QBs/passing-game coordinator in 2007–08) and was part of the Super Bowl XLIV champion Saints, then a Denver senior offensive assistant in 2024–25. The Bills named him OC on January 31, 2026; his NFL path also includes Cleveland (2000), Washington (2001), and San Diego (2002–05).

dc.name: Jim Leonhard
dc.bio: Jim Leonhard is the defensive coordinator of the Buffalo Bills in 2026. Wikipedia says he played safety 10 NFL seasons, including two Buffalo stints, after walking on at Wisconsin, then coached Wisconsin’s defense (2016–22, interim head coach in 2022) before joining Denver as defensive backs coach/pass-game coordinator in 2024 and assistant head coach/pass-game coordinator in 2025. The Bills hired him as DC on January 31, 2026 under Joe Brady.

st.name: Jeff Rodgers
st.bio: Jeff Rodgers is the special teams coordinator of the Buffalo Bills in 2026. The Bills hire story says he arrives with 22 NFL special-teams seasons and 25 years of coaching experience, most recently Arizona assistant head coach/special teams coordinator after starting with the Cardinals as ST coordinator in 2018. He previously held the ST coordinator title with Chicago (2015–17), Denver (2011–14), and Carolina (2010) and entered the NFL with San Francisco in 2003; the team says he played linebacker at North Texas from 1996–2000.

hc.name: Zac Taylor
hc.bio: Zac Taylor is the head coach of the Cincinnati Bengals in 2026, a title he has held since the club named him the 10th head coach in franchise history in February 2019. The Bengals hire bio says he was Rams quarterbacks coach in 2018 and assistant wide receivers coach in 2017, Miami assistant from 2012–15 (interim OC for the final five games of 2015), and Cincinnati’s OC/QBs coach in 2016. The team says he was Nebraska’s starting quarterback in 2005–06 and Big 12 Offensive Player of the Year in 2006.

oc.name: Dan Pitcher
oc.bio: Dan Pitcher is the offensive coordinator of the Cincinnati Bengals in 2026, as listed on the club’s finalized 2026 staff. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as a Bengals offensive assistant (2016–18), assistant quarterbacks coach (2019), quarterbacks coach (2020–23), and offensive coordinator from 2024–26 under Zac Taylor.

dc.name: Al Golden
dc.bio: Al Golden is the defensive coordinator of the Cincinnati Bengals in 2026, as listed on the club’s finalized 2026 staff. Staff-2026 nfl_history records NFL stops as Detroit tight ends coach (2016–17) and linebackers coach (2018–19), Bengals linebackers coach (2020–21), and Bengals defensive coordinator in 2025–26 under Zac Taylor.

st.name: Darrin Simmons
st.bio: Darrin Simmons is assistant head coach / special teams coordinator of the Cincinnati Bengals in 2026, as listed on the club’s finalized 2026 staff. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Baltimore assistant special teams/assistant strength in 1998, Carolina assistant ST/assistant strength from 1999–2002, Bengals special teams from 2003–19 (coordinator title from 2013), and assistant head coach/special teams coordinator from 2020–26.

hc.name: Todd Monken
hc.bio: Todd Monken is the head coach of the Cleveland Browns in 2026, the 19th full-time head coach in team history, in his first NFL head-coaching job. The Browns say he was Baltimore’s offensive coordinator for three seasons after joining in 2023, Cleveland’s OC in 2019, Tampa Bay’s OC from 2016–18, and Jacksonville’s wide receivers coach from 2007–10. The club credits him with 37 coaching seasons, including Southern Miss head coach from 2013–15 and Georgia offensive coordinator from 2020–22.

oc.name: Travis Switzer
oc.bio: Travis Switzer is the offensive coordinator of the Cleveland Browns in 2026 under Todd Monken. The Browns say he spent nine seasons with the Ravens, the last three (2023–25) as run-game coordinator on units that led the NFL in rush yards (166.9 per game) in that span. He began in Baltimore as an administrative/performance staff assistant in 2017 and later worked with wide receivers and tight ends; the team says he played four seasons as a center at Akron.

dc.name: Mike Rutenberg
dc.bio: Mike Rutenberg is the defensive coordinator of the Cleveland Browns in 2026. The Browns say he has 14 years of NFL coaching experience and spent 2025 as Atlanta’s defensive pass-game coordinator after four seasons as New York Jets linebackers coach (2021–24). He was San Francisco’s passing-game specialist in 2020 and spent seven seasons with Jacksonville (2013–19) after entering the league with Washington as a personnel intern in 2003.

st.name: Byron Storer
st.bio: Byron Storer is the special teams coordinator of the Cleveland Browns in 2026. The Browns say he has 12 NFL coaching years, including Packers assistant special teams coach from 2022–25 and Raiders assistant ST from 2018–21. He earlier assisted special teams in Tampa Bay (2010–11) and San Diego (2012) and was Chargers assistant linebackers coach in 2013; the team says he played three NFL seasons as a Buccaneers fullback from 2007–09.

hc.name: Sean Payton
hc.bio: Sean Payton is the head coach of the Denver Broncos in 2026, a job Wikipedia says he has held since 2023 after 16 seasons as New Orleans head coach (2006–21), including a Super Bowl XLIV title. Wikipedia says he played quarterback at Eastern Illinois and appeared for the 1987 Bears, and that in February 2026 he handed offensive play-calling to Davis Webb. The Broncos 2026 staff announcement lists him as head coach in his 37th coaching season.

oc.name: Davis Webb
oc.bio: Davis Webb is the offensive coordinator of the Denver Broncos in 2026, as listed on the club’s March 2026 staff update (fourth coaching season). Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Broncos quarterbacks coach in 2023–24, offensive pass-game coordinator and quarterbacks coach in 2025, and offensive coordinator from 2026. Wikipedia’s Payton page states Payton announced in February 2026 that Webb would call plays.

dc.name: Vance Joseph
dc.bio: Vance Joseph is the defensive coordinator of the Denver Broncos in 2026, as listed on the club’s March 2026 staff update (28th coaching season). Staff-2026 nfl_history records NFL stops as 49ers assistant DB (2005) and DB coach (2006–10), Texans DB coach (2011–13), Bengals DB coach (2014–15), Dolphins DC (2016), Broncos head coach (2017–18), Cardinals DC (2019–22), and Broncos DC from 2023.

st.name: Darren Rizzi
st.bio: Darren Rizzi is special teams coordinator / assistant head coach of the Denver Broncos in 2026, as listed on the club’s March 2026 staff update (34th coaching season). Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Miami assistant ST (2009) and ST coordinator (2010–18, associate HC from 2017), Saints ST coordinator (2019–24, assistant HC from 2022, interim HC in 2024), and Broncos assistant HC/ST coordinator from 2025.

hc.name: DeMeco Ryans
hc.bio: DeMeco Ryans is the head coach of the Houston Texans in 2026, a job Wikipedia says he has held since 2023. Wikipedia says he was a Texans and Eagles linebacker, 2006 Defensive Rookie of the Year, and two-time Pro Bowler, then a 49ers assistant (2017–22) and 2022 AP NFL Assistant Coach of the Year. As Texans HC his first three seasons were 10–7, 10–7, and 12–5 with a playoff berth each year; the 2026 Texans staff list names him head coach.

oc.name: Nick Caley
oc.bio: Nick Caley is the offensive coordinator of the Houston Texans in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as a Patriots offensive assistant (2015–16), tight ends coach (2017–22, also fullbacks 2020–21), Rams tight ends coach (2023) and TE/pass-game coordinator (2024), and Texans offensive coordinator from 2025.

dc.name: Matt Burke
dc.bio: Matt Burke is the defensive coordinator of the Houston Texans in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records NFL stops with Tennessee (2004–08), Detroit linebackers (2009–13), Cincinnati linebackers (2014–15), Miami linebackers (2016) and DC (2017–18), Philadelphia (2019–20), the Jets (2021), Arizona defensive line (2022), and Texans DC from 2023.

st.name: Frank Ross
st.bio: Frank Ross is the special teams coordinator of the Houston Texans in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Indianapolis assistant special teams coach from 2018–20 and Houston special teams coordinator from 2021.

hc.name: Shane Steichen
hc.bio: Shane Steichen is the head coach of the Indianapolis Colts in 2026, a job Wikipedia says he has held since February 14, 2023. Wikipedia says he was a UNLV quarterback, Chargers offensive coordinator in 2020, and Eagles OC in 2021–22, then went 9–8, 8–9, and 8–9 in his first three Colts seasons; Colts ownership said after 2025 he would remain HC for 2026. The Colts 2026 staff announcement lists him as head coach.

oc.name: Jim Bob Cooter
oc.bio: Jim Bob Cooter is the offensive coordinator of the Indianapolis Colts in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as a Colts offensive assistant (2009–11), Chiefs QC (2012), Broncos offensive assistant (2013), Lions QBs coach (2014) and OC (2015–18), Jets running backs coach (2019–20), Jaguars passing-game coordinator (2022), and Colts OC from 2023.

dc.name: Lou Anarumo
dc.bio: Lou Anarumo is the defensive coordinator of the Indianapolis Colts in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. That page notes he previously worked with new Colts DL coach Marion Hobby in Cincinnati. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Dolphins DB coach (2012–17, interim DC in 2015), Giants DB coach (2018), Bengals DC (2019–24), and Colts DC from 2025.

st.name: Brian Mason
st.bio: Brian Mason is the special teams coordinator of the Indianapolis Colts in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Colts special teams coordinator from 2023.

hc.name: Liam Coen
hc.bio: Liam Coen is the head coach of the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2026. Wikipedia says the Jaguars hired him on January 24, 2025 after he was Tampa Bay’s offensive coordinator in 2024 and Rams OC in 2022, and that he played quarterback at UMass. In his first season as HC, Wikipedia and the Jaguars coordinators story say Jacksonville went 13–4, won the AFC South, and lost a wild-card game to Buffalo.

oc.name: Grant Udinski
oc.bio: Grant Udinski is the offensive coordinator of the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2026 after agreeing to remain following 2025 head-coaching interviews with Cleveland and Buffalo. The Jaguars say the 30-year-old oversaw a 2025 offense that ranked sixth in scoring (27.9) after finishing 26th in 2024, with Trevor Lawrence setting a franchise record with 38 total touchdowns. Staff-2026 nfl_history records prior NFL stops with Carolina (2020–21) and Minnesota (2022–24).

dc.name: Anthony Campanile
dc.bio: Anthony Campanile is the defensive coordinator of the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2026 after agreeing to remain following 2025 head-coaching interviews with Arizona, Baltimore, and Miami. The Jaguars say the 43-year-old’s 2025 defense led the NFL in run defense (85.6 yards allowed) and finished second in takeaways (31). Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Dolphins linebackers coach (2020–23), Packers LB/run-game coordinator (2024), and Jaguars DC from 2025.

st.name: Heath Farwell
st.bio: Heath Farwell is associate head coach / special teams coordinator of the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history, which cites the Jaguars return coverage, records him as Seahawks assistant ST (2016–17), Panthers assistant ST (2018), Bills ST coordinator (2019–21), Jaguars ST coordinator (2022–25), and associate HC/ST coordinator from 2026.

hc.name: Andy Reid
hc.bio: Andy Reid is the head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs in 2026, a job Wikipedia says he has held since 2013 after 14 seasons as Philadelphia head coach (1999–2012). Wikipedia says he is the only NFL coach with 100 wins for two franchises and has three Super Bowl titles as Chiefs HC (LIV, LVII, LVIII). The 2025 Chiefs finished 6–11 and missed the playoffs, ending a nine-year AFC West streak; Wikipedia lists him as the league’s longest-tenured coach with one team entering 2026.

oc.name: Eric Bieniemy
oc.bio: Eric Bieniemy is the offensive coordinator of the Kansas City Chiefs in 2026, his second stint in the role after 2018–22. The Chiefs hire story says Kansas City led the NFL in points (30.1), total touchdowns (296), third-down rate (49%), and yards per game (406.2) in that first stint. He was Washington’s OC in 2023, on UCLA’s staff in 2024, and Chicago’s running backs coach in 2025, when the Bears ranked third in rushing (144.5 ypg).

dc.name: Steve Spagnuolo
dc.bio: Steve Spagnuolo is the defensive coordinator of the Kansas City Chiefs in 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history, citing the 2026 Chiefs season Wikipedia page, records him as an Eagles assistant (1999–2006), Giants DC (2007–08 and 2015–17, interim HC in 2017), Rams head coach (2009–11), Saints DC (2012), Ravens assistant (2013–14), and Chiefs DC from 2019.

st.name: Dave Toub
st.bio: Dave Toub is assistant head coach / special teams coordinator of the Kansas City Chiefs in 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history, citing the 2026 Chiefs season Wikipedia page, records him as Eagles special teams/QC (2001–03), Bears ST coordinator (2004–12), Chiefs ST coordinator (2013–17), and Chiefs assistant HC/ST coordinator from 2018.

hc.name: Jim Harbaugh
hc.bio: Jim Harbaugh is the head coach of the Los Angeles Chargers in 2026. Wikipedia says the Chargers hired him on January 24, 2024 after he won the 2023 college national title at Michigan, and that he played quarterback at Michigan and 14 NFL seasons. Wikipedia lists Chargers records of 11–6 in 2024 and 11–6 in 2025 with wild-card losses each year; the Chargers 2026 staff list names him head coach.

oc.name: Mike McDaniel
oc.bio: Mike McDaniel is the offensive coordinator of the Los Angeles Chargers in 2026, as listed on the club’s May 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records NFL stops including Broncos intern (2005), Texans (2006–08), Washington (2011–13), Browns WR coach (2014), Falcons (2015–16), 49ers (2017–21, OC in 2021), Dolphins head coach (2022–25), and Chargers OC from 2026.

dc.name: Chris O'Leary
dc.bio: Chris O'Leary is the defensive coordinator of the Los Angeles Chargers in 2026, as listed on the club’s May 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Chargers safeties coach in 2024 and Chargers defensive coordinator from 2026. The same Chargers page notes a 2026 coaching fellow had worked with O’Leary at Western Michigan in 2025.

st.name: Ryan Ficken
st.bio: Ryan Ficken is the special teams coordinator of the Los Angeles Chargers in 2026, as listed on the club’s May 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as a Vikings assistant (2007–20) and ST coordinator (2021) and Chargers special teams coordinator from 2022.

hc.name: Klint Kubiak
hc.bio: Klint Kubiak is the head coach of the Las Vegas Raiders in 2026, named on February 9, 2026 after Seattle’s Super Bowl LX win. The Raiders say he was Seahawks OC in 2025 on an offense that ranked third in scoring (28.4) and set a franchise points record (483). He was Saints OC in 2024, 49ers passing-game coordinator in 2023, and earlier coached for Minnesota and Denver; the team says he played safety at Colorado State.

oc.name: Andrew Janocko
oc.bio: Andrew Janocko is the offensive coordinator of the Las Vegas Raiders in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Buccaneers offensive QC (2012–13); Vikings QC, OL, WR, and QB roles (2015–21); Bears QBs coach (2022–23); Saints QBs coach (2024); Seahawks QBs coach (2025); and Raiders OC from 2026.

dc.name: Rob Leonard
dc.bio: Rob Leonard is the defensive coordinator of the Las Vegas Raiders in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records Giants assistant roles (2013–18), Dolphins line roles (2019–21), Ravens outside linebackers (2022), Raiders defensive line (2023–24) and DL/run-game coordinator (2025), and Raiders DC from 2026.

st.name: Joe DeCamillis
st.bio: Joe DeCamillis is the special teams coordinator of the Las Vegas Raiders in 2026, as listed on the club’s 2026 staff announcement. Staff-2026 nfl_history records NFL special-teams jobs from 1991 with Denver, the Giants, Atlanta, Jacksonville, Dallas, Chicago, Denver again, Jacksonville again, the Rams (2021–22), and the Raiders from 2026.

hc.name: Jeff Hafley
hc.bio: Jeff Hafley is the head coach of the Miami Dolphins in 2026, the 12th in franchise history after the club agreed to terms on January 19, 2026. Wikipedia says he was Green Bay’s defensive coordinator in 2024–25 and Boston College head coach from 2020–23 (22–26), and that he played wide receiver at Siena. The Dolphins 2026 staff announcement lists him as head coach over coordinators Bobby Slowik, Sean Duggan, and Chris Tabor.

oc.name: Bobby Slowik
oc.bio: Bobby Slowik is the offensive coordinator of the Miami Dolphins in 2026. The Dolphins staff announcement says he was promoted after serving as senior pass-game coordinator in 2025 and has 12 NFL coaching years, including Houston OC in 2023–24, when C.J. Stroud was 2023 PFWA Offensive Rookie of the Year. He spent six seasons in San Francisco (2017–22) and began as a Washington defensive assistant (2011–13).

dc.name: Sean Duggan
dc.bio: Sean Duggan is the defensive coordinator of the Miami Dolphins in 2026. The Dolphins staff announcement says he spent 2024 as a Packers defensive assistant and 2025 as Packers linebackers coach, with Green Bay ranking ninth in total defense (313.2 ypg) over those two seasons. He coached linebackers at Boston College from 2020–23 (co-DC in 2023) after stops at Ohio State, Hawai‘i, UMass, and Boston College as a graduate assistant.

st.name: Chris Tabor
st.bio: Chris Tabor is the special teams coordinator of the Miami Dolphins in 2026. The Dolphins staff announcement says he has 17 NFL seasons and 14 as a coordinator, including Buffalo in 2025, Carolina in 2022–23, Chicago in 2018–21, and Cleveland in 2011–17. In 2025 Buffalo ranked fourth in kickoff-return average (27.9) and eighth in field-goal percentage (90.5%).

hc.name: Mike Vrabel
hc.bio: Mike Vrabel is the head coach of the New England Patriots in 2026, the 16th in franchise history after the club named him on January 12, 2025. Wikipedia says he played linebacker 14 NFL seasons, won three Super Bowls with New England, and was Titans head coach from 2018–23. In 2025 he led New England to a 14–3 record, Super Bowl LX (a loss to Seattle), and a second AP Coach of the Year award.

oc.name: Josh McDaniels
oc.bio: Josh McDaniels is the offensive coordinator of the New England Patriots in 2026. Wikipedia says he rejoined New England in 2025 for a third OC stint and won 2025 AP NFL Assistant Coach of the Year after the Patriots averaged 28.8 points per game. He was Broncos head coach (2009–10) and Raiders head coach (2022–23) and was part of six Super Bowl-winning Patriots staffs; Wikipedia says he played wide receiver at John Carroll.

dc.name: Zak Kuhr
dc.bio: Zak Kuhr is the defensive coordinator of the New England Patriots in 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history, citing the Patriots promotion story, records him as Titans defensive quality control (2020) and inside linebackers assistant (2021–23), Giants defensive assistant (2024), Patriots inside linebackers coach in 2025 (de facto DC and play-caller after Week 1), and Patriots defensive coordinator in 2026.

st.name: Jeremy Springer
st.bio: Jeremy Springer is the special teams coordinator of the New England Patriots in 2026, as listed on the club’s coaches roster used in staff-2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Rams assistant special teams coach in 2022–23 and Patriots special teams coordinator from 2024.

hc.name: Aaron Glenn
hc.bio: Aaron Glenn is the head coach of the New York Jets in 2026, the 22nd in franchise history after the club hired him on January 22, 2025. Wikipedia and Jets.com say he was a Jets first-round cornerback (1994–2001), a three-time Pro Bowler, Lions defensive coordinator from 2021–24, and a Jets scout in 2012–13. Wikipedia says the 2025 Jets finished 3–14; he remains head coach in 2026.

oc.name: Frank Reich
oc.bio: Frank Reich is the offensive coordinator of the New York Jets in 2026. Wikipedia’s Aaron Glenn page says Glenn hired Reich on February 4, 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history records Reich as a Colts assistant (2006–11), Cardinals and Chargers assistant, Chargers OC (2014–15), Eagles OC (2016–17), Colts head coach (2018–22), Panthers head coach (2023), and Jets OC in 2026.

dc.name: Brian Duker
dc.bio: Brian Duker is the defensive coordinator of the New York Jets in 2026. Wikipedia’s Aaron Glenn page says Glenn hired him on January 28, 2026 after Duker was Miami’s secondary coach. Staff-2026 nfl_history records NFL stops with Cleveland (2015), San Francisco (2016), Baltimore (2018–20), Detroit (2021–23), Miami (2024–25), and the Jets in 2026.

st.name: Chris Banjo
st.bio: Chris Banjo is the special teams coordinator of the New York Jets in 2026, as listed on the club’s coaches roster used in staff-2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history records him as Broncos assistant special teams coach in 2023–24 and Jets special teams coordinator from 2025.

hc.name: Mike McCarthy
hc.bio: Mike McCarthy is the head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2026, the 17th in team history and a Pittsburgh native. The Steelers introduction says he has 18 prior HC seasons with Green Bay (2006–18) and Dallas (2020–24), a 174–112–2 regular-season record, and a Super Bowl XLV title with the Packers. He was Saints OC (2000–04) and 49ers OC (2005) and began in the NFL with Kansas City in 1993.

oc.name: Brian Angelichio
oc.bio: Brian Angelichio is the offensive coordinator of the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2026. The Steelers complete-staff URL in staff-2026 names him OC; nfl_history records him as tight ends coach with Tampa Bay (2012–13), Cleveland (2014–15), Green Bay (2016–18), Washington (2019), and Carolina (2020–21), Vikings passing-game coordinator/tight ends (2022–25), and Steelers OC in 2026.

dc.name: Patrick Graham
dc.bio: Patrick Graham is the defensive coordinator of the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2026. The Steelers complete-staff URL in staff-2026 names him DC; nfl_history records Patriots assistant roles (2009–15), Giants DL (2016–17), Packers ILB/run-game coordinator (2018), Dolphins DC (2019), Giants AHC/DC (2020–21), Raiders DC (2022–25), and Steelers DC in 2026.

st.name: Danny Crossman
st.bio: Danny Crossman is the special teams coordinator of the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2026. The Steelers complete-staff URL in staff-2026 names him ST coordinator; nfl_history records Carolina ST roles (2003–09), Lions STC (2010–12), Bills STC (2013–18), Dolphins STC (2019–24, assistant HC in 2021), and Steelers STC in 2026.

hc.name: Robert Saleh
hc.bio: Robert Saleh is the head coach of the Tennessee Titans in 2026, the 22nd coach in Oilers/Titans history after signing on January 22, 2026. The Titans hire story says he was 49ers defensive coordinator in 2025 and Jets head coach from 2021–24 (20–36), and earlier 49ers DC from 2017–20. The team says he started at tight end for four years at Northern Michigan.

oc.name: Brian Daboll
oc.bio: Brian Daboll is the offensive coordinator of the Tennessee Titans in 2026, as previously announced and restated when the Titans finalized the staff on February 20, 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history records Patriots, Jets, Browns, Dolphins, Chiefs, and Bills assistant/OC jobs, Giants head coach from 2022–25, and Titans OC from 2026.

dc.name: Gus Bradley
dc.bio: Gus Bradley is the defensive coordinator of the Tennessee Titans in 2026, as previously announced and restated when the Titans finalized the staff on February 20, 2026. Staff-2026 nfl_history records Buccaneers LB coach (2006–08), Seahawks DC (2009–12), Jaguars head coach (2013–16), Chargers DC (2017–20), Raiders DC (2021), Colts DC (2022–24), 49ers assistant head coach (2025), and Titans DC from 2026.

st.name: John Fassel
st.bio: John Fassel is assistant head coach / special teams coordinator of the Tennessee Titans in 2026. The Titans February 20 staff story restates that title. Staff-2026 nfl_history records Ravens assistant ST (2005–07), Raiders STC (2008–11), Rams STC (2012–19, interim HC in 2016), Cowboys STC (2020–24), Titans STC (2025), and assistant HC/STC from 2026.
